Note Way 1.0.4 for Mac is out.

Hold a key, say what's on your mind, and it lands in your day: an event in your calendar, a task in Today, or a page in the right topic. Clear sentences save right away. It only asks when something is really open.

Built solo, Mac first. 3 days free, no card: https://noteway.ai
